profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Emerson Power and Water Solutions

positions.title: Project Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
- Manage electrical contractors, scheduling and budget for Electrical Facilities and Machine 
installation.
- Supervise and inspect Electrical installation comply with Electrical Codes NEC/NFPA 70
- Acting Construction Manager for the project, budget forecasting, managing contractors, 
scheduling project timelines, conduct safety activities onsite, drive resolutions and 
coordination between; Project Managers, Subject Matter Experts, Field Engineers, Plant 
personnel and Site contractors.

positions.title: Electrical and Computer Engineer Staff
positions.description:
- Provide Technical Support for equipment across the world for Final Finish area.
- Equipment installation and Commissioning for Final Finish area in multiples plants across the world. 
- Development, deployment and maintenance of enterprise software for machine-server communication within Final Finish area for plants across the world. 
- Review equipment for compliance with Goodyear Technical specs and Electrical Spec as NEC/NFPA 70/ANSI-RIA. 
- Scope, review and develop with vendor new Robotic solution for Final Finish area, including software development for machine-server communications. 
- Coding Experience: C/C#, Python, HTML, CSS, JS, Apache Karaf, Apache Camel, ActiveMQ, SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Review, design and implementation of plant requirements to improve production throughput.
- Work as a link between Production, Quality and Maintenance 
- Support maintenance team with troubleshooting. 
- Support project team with new equipment installation and coordination with contractors.

positions.title: Electronic Project Engineer
positions.description:
- Support project team with new equipment installation and coordination with contractors.
- Provide support and industrialization and production phase for new equipment.

positions.title: Electronic Maintenance Engineer
positions.description:
- Preventive Maintenance on Final Finish equipment focused on increasing OEE.
- Provide troubleshooting and production support during equipment downtime.
